entries.title: Half the tool descriptions never said what the tool would not do
entries.summary: Scored every tool description against the rubric in arXiv:2602.14878, which found 97.1% of 856 MCP tools carrying at least one description smell. Half of ours never said what they do not return or when they refuse; 42 tools here got a limitation clause derived from their own guard clauses and schema defaults.
